data.name: Riqqah
data.long_meaning: The name Riqqah is derived from the Arabic word 'riqqa' which means a beautiful necklace. It is a name that evokes elegance, grace and sophistication.
data.spiritual_meaning: The spiritual meaning of the name Riqqah is one that symbolizes adornment and embellishment of the soul. It is a name that invokes the beauty of the inner self and encourages self-love and self-care.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Riqqah resonates with the vibrations of the number 6, which represents nurturing, caring and giving. It is a name that encourages one to be of service to others and to find joy in making others happy.

in_arabic.name: رِقّاح
in_arabic.meaning: الرِقّاحة هي القوة والقوة التي تُستخدم في التحرير والحرية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم رِقّاح مشتق من الجذر ر-ق-ح، ويأتي من اللفظ الرِقّاح، الذي يعني قوة وفراسة، وحكمة، وذكاء. وفي القرآن الكريم، يصف الله تعالى بالرِقّاح، في سورة الشورى: "قُل لَهُمْ أَتَدْرُونَ مَا هِيَ الرِقّاحُ" (الشورى: 20). وفي الحديث النبوي الشريف، يقول رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "الرِقّاحُ في الأسباب ما الحكمة في الأمور".

in_urdu.name: ریقاح
in_urdu.meaning: ریقاح ایک ایسی قوت ہے جو آزادی اور تحریر جیتنے میں مدد دیتی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم ریقاح اس جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے جو ریقح سے مشتق ہے، اور اس کے معنی قوت اور فراست کے ہیں۔ اس کے علاوہ یہ حکیمانہ اور ذکاوت کے بھی معنی کا حامل ہے۔ اس کے استعمال کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں بھی کیا گیا ہے۔ سورة الشوریٰ میں اسی کا ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रिक्काह

in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम रिक्काह आरब-क-ह जड़ से लिया गया है, और इसके अर्थ शक्ति और बुद्धिमत्ता है। इसे भी दिव्य बुद्धि का प्रतीक माना जाता है। कुरान में इसका जिक्र है, जिसे शूरा सूरह के 20 वें आयत में दिया गया है।

in_pashto.name: ریقاح
in_pashto.meaning: ریقاح د هرګړې او آزادۍ ته وده کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: ریقاح د ریقح جګړې له پرمخ لیکل کېدو څخه رخص کړی دی، چې د قوت او ښه څرځونې لامل دی. د ریقاح د ځینو معانیو ته د افغانستان او پختونستان د تاریخي پرمختیا وده کړی دی.

in_english.name: Riqqah
in_english.meaning: Riqqah is a power that helps in gaining freedom and liberation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Riqqah is derived from the root Reb-Qa-H, and it means power, wisdom, and intelligence. In the Quran, Allah refers to the Riqqah, in Surah Al-Shura: "Say to them: Do you know what the Riqqah is?" (Al-Shura: 20). In the Hadith, Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said: "The Riqqah in the causes is like wisdom in matters."

data.cultural_impact: Riqqah, being a name associated with a beautiful necklace, symbolizes adornment and beauty in Islamic culture. In Islamic art, geometric patterns and intricate calligraphy adorn walls, carpets, and pottery, giving a sense of elegance and refinement. Riqqah can also symbolize the concept of 'rhyme and reason,' with the words in a beautiful poem or song coming together in perfect harmony like the beads on a necklace.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Riqqah holds spiritual significance in Islam through its association with inner adornment. A Verse in the Quran reads: "We have adorned the lower heavens with beautiful stars for those who protect themselves [from evil]" (Al-Mulk 67:4). The verse suggests that through our actions and protection of our faith and morals, Allah adorns us with His blessings and rewards. Similarly, the name Riqqah can represent the idea of adorning one's inner self with virtues and good deeds, creating a beautiful soul that radiates peace and serenity.
